visualCharacteristics: Stacked expandable question/answer items with a chevron toggle; optional title row above the list.
contentPattern: Optional first row with the accordion title, then one row per item: cell 1 question, cell 2 answer (rich text).
usage: FAQ-style expandable content on static and locale home pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any expand/collapse list of question and answer pairs.
